title: 2026-11-10 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：ISER-MoE (NVIDIA, 热门专家复制走交换机内组播，每字节只出一次。)、ReKV (机构未标注, 传量化前缀，飞在途时重算后缀。)、FOSCAR (Together AI, 逐值反量化是瓶颈，把 scale/offset 折进 matmul。)、Nebula (Xiaohongshu, PIC 片段加集群级调度，TTFT 砍 61%。)、DataHelix (Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 用 GPU 计算窗口给 CPU 预处理定截止期。)、RPEG (ETH Zurich, 用图 IR 统一 RL 训练的结构与执行优化。)、Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline for Multi-Instance Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning (Ecole Polytechnique, 离线预处理削三类气泡，rollout 吞吐 3.22×。)、Two-Layer Evolutionary Scheduling for Machine Learning Jobs in Multi-Cluster Environments (SUSTech, 进化算法分集群，GP 学优先级函数排作业。)

highlights.name: ISER-MoE
highlights.note: NVLink 交换机内组播热门专家，DeepSeek-V4-Pro prefill 吞吐 +17.4%

highlights.name: FOSCAR
highlights.note: 仿射折叠把 scale/offset 折进 matmul，H100 INT2 decode 快 3.36×

highlights.name: ReKV
highlights.note: 量化 KV 传输与后缀重算重叠，8K 交接延迟最多降 3.65×
